flavor.phonemic_palette: Kobold (Kazhur, yip-click regression): q -> k' (click), k -> tk', sh -> ts', finals dropped/clipped, vowels raise to i/e, diminutive -ik/-ek; shrill, quick, high.

religion_hooks.alignment_lens: Resolved per the culture's chosen alignment (setting-lore §4.2): Lawful venerates the 12 Lawful powers and names the 13 as demons; Chaotic venerates the 13 and names the 12 as tyrant-gods; Neutral venerates this culture's ancestral saints, invoking the great gods only situationally.

flavor_text.one_line: Kobold — xenophobic tribal of the hills; survival.
flavor_text.one_paragraph: The Kobold are a Chaotic beastman race; aggression 0.5, organized as tribal. Their tongue is a regressed form (see name_bank 'kobold'). Stripped record per gdd-culture-catalog §5.3.
